BiblicalUsage: Urine is the word Rabshakeh throws at the men on the wall: hath my master sent me to speak these words, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own water? The same taunt stands in Kings and in Isaiah, word for word. Scripture does not clean it up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the taunt is recorded because the siege was real, for Rabshakeh meant to break Jerusalem with filth and fear, and I hold that God answered him, not by cleaning the words, but by breaking the army.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
